project_info.theme: Luxury fashion editorial in a vintage library
project_info.color_palette: dark walnut, antique gold, champagne satin, cream, muted butterfly tones and soft gray fog

main_subject.type: adult woman fashion model and luxury handbag
main_subject.detail: Adult woman with short wavy bob hair and soft natural makeup sits centered on antique books, wearing an elegant flowing champagne satin gown with one hand resting against her face. A luxury designer handbag is prominently placed in front.
main_subject.style: cinematic high-fashion magazine editorial with natural skin texture and refined luxury styling

composition_elements.layout: symmetrical vertical portrait with woman centered on stacked antique books, handbag in foreground and tall shelves receding on both sides
composition_elements.text: Preserve approved campaign typography: GUCCI and GUCCI: BEYOND IMAGINATION only when licensed.
items: glowing butterflies floating at varied depths
champagne satin train spreading across books

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: narrow overhead spotlight at 4300K with low warm bounce and subtle shelf practicals
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: dramatic pool of light, rich walnut shadows, satin highlights, volumetric fog and gentle butterfly glow

technical_specs.render_style: Hasselblad X2D 100C, XCD 80mm f/1.9, luxury fashion editorial photography
technical_specs.optics: shallow depth of field, crisp handbag details, natural vignetting and restrained film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic luxury fashion editorial set inside a grand vintage library with tall wooden bookshelves, soft fog covering the floor and glowing butterflies floating in the air. An adult woman with short wavy bob hair and soft natural makeup sits centered on a stack of antique books. She wears an elegant flowing satin gown in champagne color, posed gracefully with one hand resting on her face. A luxury designer handbag is placed prominently in front. Use a dramatic spotlight from above, symmetrical composition, moody atmosphere, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic high detail, 8K, fashion magazine style, premium aesthetic, soft shadows and rich tones. Preserve approved campaign typography only when licensed.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, malformed handbag, incorrect logo, unreadable typography, duplicated butterflies, cluttered shelves
